response.justification: The candidate is a strong generalist engineer with broad full-stack and systems experience, but does not meet the core requirements of this role. His C++ experience is limited to a ~7-month stint at National Instruments in 2014–2015 and a thesis project, far short of the mandatory 5–10 years of hands-on Windows C++ development. He also lacks meaningful capital markets or fixed-income domain expertise, and his database experience (MongoDB, MySQL) does not clearly cover SQL Server or Oracle.
strengths: Strong low-latency systems experience (DLang microservices handling millions of requests/sec)
Solid engineering practices: TDD, CI/CD, DevOps tooling, and testing frameworks
Broad polyglot background with some Java and scripting proficiency (desirable extras)
concerns: Only ~7 months of professional C++ experience, over a decade ago
No fixed income, capital markets, or investment banking domain experience
No demonstrated SQL Server/Oracle or Windows-platform development background

key_factors.factor: No capital markets / fixed income domain knowledge
Strong general engineering and CI/CD fundamentals
